# Lab 11.1: Set Up Continuous Queries

## What We Are Going to Do
Create an Enterprise reservation with a CONTINUOUS assignment, a service account for continuous queries, and a source table. A reservation is billed every hour, so finish Labs 11.1–11.5 in one sitting and delete it in Lab 11.5.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create the dataset and source table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab11
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false '
CREATE TABLE lab11.rides (
  ride_id STRING, city STRING, fare FLOAT64, distance_km FLOAT64, feedback STRING, ride_ts TIMESTAMP
)'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[Console] Create the reservation.** **Administration → Workload management → Create reservation**:
   - **Name**: `lab-cq`, **Location**: US
   - **Edition**: Enterprise
   - **Baseline slots**: 50, **Max slots**: 50

3. **[CLI] Assign the project for continuous queries.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq mk --reservation_assignment --reservation_id=$PROJECT_ID:US.lab-cq \
  --job_type=CONTINUOUS --assignee_type=PROJECT --assignee_id=$PROJECT_ID
bq ls --reservation_assignment --location=US</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   You can also create the reservation itself from the CLI: `bq mk --reservation --location=US --edition=ENTERPRISE --slots=50 lab-cq`.

4. **[CLI] Create a service account for the query.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts create bq-continuous --display-name="BQ continuous queries"
CQ_SA=bq-continuous@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com
for ROLE in roles/bigquery.dataEditor roles/bigquery.jobUser roles/bigquery.connectionUser roles/pubsub.publisher roles/pubsub.viewer; do
  gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding $PROJECT_ID --member=serviceAccount:$CQ_SA --role=$ROLE --quiet
done
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding $CQ_SA \
  --member="user:$(gcloud config get-value account)" --role=roles/iam.serviceAccountUser</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   A long-running query should not depend on your personal login, so it runs as this service account.

5. **[CLI] Write a simple data generator.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">cat &gt; gen_rides.sh &lt;&lt;'EOF'
for i in $(seq 1 20); do
  bq query --use_legacy_sql=false --nouse_cache "
  INSERT INTO lab11.rides VALUES (GENERATE_UUID(),
    ['Surat','Pune','Delhi'][OFFSET(MOD($i,3))], ROUND(RAND()*200,2), ROUND(RAND()*30,1),
    ['Great ride','Driver was rude','Car was dirty','Fast and safe'][OFFSET(MOD($i,4))], CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())" &gt; /dev/null
  echo "inserted $i"; sleep 5
done
EOF
chmod +x gen_rides.sh</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Reservation | Enterprise, 50 slots |
| Assignment | Job type `CONTINUOUS` |
| Identity | Dedicated service account |
| Cost | Hourly slot charge while the reservation exists |
